design_token_violations.line_hint: private func nodeColor\(_ node: OrganismNode\) -> SIMD4<Float>
design_token_violations.issue: 11 inline SIMD4<Float> color literals hardcode all spec tokens (e.g. SIMD4(0.000, 0.831, 1.000, 1.00) for #00D4FF violet). Metal cannot use SwiftUI Color, but a shared struct MetalColors mirroring DSColors.Spec as SIMD4 constants would make token maintenance single-source.

kMetalBgColor = MTLClearColor(red: 0.039, green: 0.055, blue: 0.153, alpha: 1.0) hardcodes the bg token (#0A0E27) as raw floats; should be a shared constant derived from DSColors.Spec.bg component values.

notes: The implementation is largely faithful to the spec: all 9 design tokens are correctly defined, all 6 left-rail modes are present and wired, the organism map topology is complete and geometrically correct (all interior nodes verified inside the dashed ellipse, all exterior nodes verified outside), the VoiceOverlayPill floats above every view, and the timeline colour-coding uses spec tokens. Three meaningful gaps exist: the proof block lists only 4 of the stated 10 proofs; the YubiKey SwiftUI label colour diverges from the Metal node colour; and OmegaView.swift is a non-trivial view file that is unreachable from any navigation mode. The only design-token violations are in Metal-layer files where SwiftUI Color is architecturally unavailable — the raw float values match the spec exactly but are inline duplicates rather than pointing to a single shared bridge. The Board chamber node is at normalised ellipse distance 0.996, visually on the inner edge of the constitutional boundary; this is mathematically inside but warrants attention if the ellipse geometry is ever adjusted.
